description: Metadata for public Stanford Artificial Intelligence Laboratory research and news HTML on ai.stanford.edu and www.ai.stanford.edu. www.ai.stanford.edu does not resolve, so that host is empty. Each stored URL was one bounded GET that robots.txt allowed and returned HTML on ai.stanford.edu. Person profiles, login walls, PDFs, challenges, captchas, HTML robots.txt, and off-host redirects are omitted. Rows store title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page text, abstracts, quotes, transcripts, PDFs, and chart data are not stored. creative_commons_attribution is CC BY alone. creative_commons is CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix. A sole restricted deed keeps its token. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. Not a belief collector. runner_wired is false.
